ideas.pitch: An AI Employee built on Supervity Auto that automatically cross-references local Gujarat textile export invoices with GST and customs databases, flagging compliance exceptions for human review.
ideas.title: Supervity Auto-Pilot Textile Compliance Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the core evaluation criteria of solving a real enterprise operations problem relevant to Gujarat's manufacturing hub while demonstrating robust exception handling in Supervity Auto.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI workflow agent using Supervity Auto to ingest incoming PDF purchase orders from local ceramic and chemical manufacturers and automatically orchestrate ERP and dispatch systems.
ideas.title: SupplyChain Auto-Dispatcher for Gujarat Logistics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with Supervity's mission of executing meaningful work across business systems while keeping humans in control of exceptions.

ideas.pitch: A no-code AI Employee that automates the multi-system corporate onboarding process across email, payroll, and IT asset management, featuring a dedicated human-in-the-loop approval gate.
ideas.title: Auto-HR Onboarding Orchestrator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on business process design and exception handling, which are primary evaluation criteria for Supervity hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An AI workflow agent that monitors corporate inbox streams, extracts line items from varied vendor invoice formats, matches them against inventory logs, and flags discrepancies for financial controllers.
ideas.title: Automated Vendor Invoice Reconciliation Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a universal enterprise operations pain point with a clear demonstration of workflow design and exception handling using no-code tools.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent triage AI Employee that categorizes incoming enterprise support tickets, triggers automated backend refunds or status checks, and escalates complex edge cases to human managers.
ideas.title: Customer Support Escalation Auto-Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates high practical utility for enterprise operations and highlights clean human-in-the-loop exception management.
